recipe.title: Hotel Sambar Recipe

steps.text: Rinse the toor dal well under water (or soak briefly if you prefer).
steps.label: Rinse dal

steps.text: Heat 2–3 tablespoons oil in the pressure cooker.
steps.label: Heat oil

steps.text: Add 1 tablespoon mustard (राई), 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida and a generous handful of curry leaves; let the curry leaf aroma come into the oil.
steps.label: Temper spices

steps.text: Add the onions (small sambar onions or a finely chopped large onion) and sauté.
steps.label: Sauté onion

steps.text: Add the vegetables (pumpkin, drumstick, potato, bottle gourd and any other veg you like) and sauté for 3 to 4 minutes.
steps.label: Cook vegetables
steps.attention_cue: तीन से 4 मिनट तक भून लेना है
steps.doneness_cue: तीन से 4 मिनट तक भून लेना है

steps.text: Add tomatoes, sprinkle salt and cook until the tomatoes soften (about 2 minutes).
steps.label: Cook tomatoes
steps.doneness_cue: टमाटर को थोड़ा सा सॉफ्ट कर लेंगे मतलब दो मिनट के लिए पका लें

steps.text: Add turmeric, red chilli powder and sambar masala (mentioned amounts) and mix into the vegetables.
steps.label: Add spices

steps.text: Add the rinsed/soaked toor dal to the masala-vegetable mixture and mix well; add water (she used 4 cups for 1/2 cup dal) and a little more salt if needed.
steps.label: Combine dal and water

steps.text: Close the pressure cooker and cook on medium flame until four whistles come (मीडियम फ्लेम पे चार सिटी आने तक पका ले).
steps.label: Pressure cook
steps.attention_cue: मीडियम फ्लेम पे चार सिटी आने तक पका ले

steps.text: Turn off the gas and let the pressure cooker cool down on its own until it is safe to open (प्रेशर कुकर खुद से ठंडा हो जाने देंगे).
steps.label: Release pressure
steps.attention_cue: प्रेशर कुकर खुद से ठंडा हो जाने देंगे

steps.text: Open the cooker carefully; you can mash some of the vegetables slightly if you want a thinner, more uniform gravy (थोड़ा सा सब्जियों को आप मैश कर सकते हैं).
steps.label: Mash veg (optional)
steps.role_cue: थोड़ा सा सब्जियों को आप मैश कर सकते हैं

steps.text: If the sambar is too thick, add normal or hot water to adjust the thickness.
steps.label: Adjust thickness

steps.text: Add 1 teaspoon jaggery (or sugar) for sweetness and 3 tablespoons tamarind pulp/juice; mix well.
steps.label: Add jaggery & tamarind

steps.text: Heat a small tadka pan with 2 tablespoons oil; when hot add 2–3 dried red chillies and some fresh curry leaves and let them sizzle.
steps.label: Make tadka

steps.text: Add one small teaspoon sambar masala to the tadka; if you want extra color you can add about half a teaspoon Kashmiri red chilli powder (यह इसमें ऑप्शनल है — बस कलर के लिए).
steps.label: Spice tadka

steps.text: Pour the tadka over the sambar and let the tadka flavor infuse for about one minute with the gas off.
steps.label: Add tadka
steps.attention_cue: एक मिनट के लिए छोड़ दिया था गैस बंद रखा है

steps.text: Serve hot with steamed rice, idli, dosa or uttapam.
steps.label: Serve

notes: Method grounded in the video's Hindi transcript (steps and exact phrases like 'तीन से 4 मिनट तक भून लेना है', 'मीडियम फ्लेम पे चार सिटी आने तक पका ले', and 'प्रेशर कुकर खुद से ठंडा हो जाने देंगे' are quoted).
Ingredients list taken verbatim from the video description.
I treated 'थोड़ा सा सब्जियों को आप मैश कर सकते हैं' as an optional step and linked it to the opening step for attachment.

Duration for pressure cooking was not given in minutes (the video says 'चार सिटी' = four whistles); I did not mark that as a stated minute duration and provided an estimated time window instead per instructions.
